		state = State.OPEN

	match state:
		State.CLOSED:

		State.OPENING:
			return "OPENING"
		State.OPEN:
			return "OPEN"
	return ""

results.title: Wait for a signal or a timeout

first.code:
extends Node

func wait_for(sig: Signal, seconds: float) -> bool:
	var signal_received = false
	var completed = false

	var sig_handler = func():
		signal_received = true
		completed = true

	var timer_handler = func():
		completed = true

	sig.connect(sig_handler)

	var timer = get_tree().create_timer(seconds)
	timer.timeout.connect(timer_handler)

	while not completed:
		await get_tree().process_frame

	sig.disconnect(sig_handler)
	timer.timeout.disconnect(timer_handler)

	return signal_received

extends Node

func wait_for(sig: Signal, seconds: float) -> bool:
	var signal_received = false

	var callback = func():
		signal_received = true

	sig.connect(callback)

	var elapsed = 0.0
	while elapsed < seconds:
		await get_tree().process_frame
		elapsed += get_process_delta_time()
		if signal_received:
			sig.disconnect(callback)
			return true

	sig.disconnect(callback)
	return false
